description: Global Nearest Neighbor — fast, deterministic. v3.7.x: gate 45->60 and confirm 20->15 keep angular-noisy radar detections assigned to a single track (previously fragmented into several tracks plus a coasting track that diverged ~15 km); added an IMM filter block (scale_accel_vert 10) matching the validated single-target autotuned config for stable position tracking.
